units.source_text: 当然了，要是不用杀男人就能霸占女人，也挺好的。

en.t: Of course, if I could have taken the woman without killing the man, that would have been best.

units.source_text: 对了，当时我也想过不杀男人也能抢走女人的办法。

en.t: Yes, at the time I had also thought about a way to carry off the woman without killing the man.

units.source_text: 不过在那山科的驿路上面，没什么好办法，

en.t: But on that road through Yamashina, there was no good way to do it,

units.source_text: 因此我才设计骗他们进山的。

en.t: so I deliberately tricked them into going into the mountains.
